lines: כִּי בַּעַל הַחֲתֻנָּה נָדִיב בְּלִי סָפֵק
אָז תִּבְכֶּה וְלֹא תוּכַל עוֹד לָבוֹא

review: The hymn is the wedding-feast parable: 1:1–8 is Matt 22:4 with Luke 14:22 and Isa 61:10, 2:1–8 is Luke 14:16–20 with 1 Cor 2:9, 3:1–8 is Rev 5:9 with 1 Pet 1:19 and Ps 55:23, and 4:1–8 is Luke 13:25–27 with Matt 25:10–12.

The refrain יֵשׁ לְךָ מָקוֹם alternates with יֵשׁ גַּם־מָקוֹם exactly as the print alternates يُوجَدُ لَكَ مَكَان / يُوجَدُ أَيْضًا مَكَان; the payload keeps both forms, since the shift from 'a place for you' to 'a place as well' is the stanza's quiet insistence that room remains.

4:4 leaves the quoted answer without a colon on the line before it, because 4:3 already ends with the colon and the print's quotation begins there; the Hebrew keeps the sentence running rather than breaking it twice.
